`chord-type-data.ts` is the chord list from tonal's `packages/chord-type/data.ts`
(https://github.com/tonaljs/tonal, commit e555422, MIT licence - see LICENSE). Its source is
Wikibooks' "Music Theory/Complete List of Chord Patterns".
`Tests/tools/make_chord_db.py` turns it into `Source/engine/ChordDatabase.cpp`.
